metadata.title: GRC Engineering Pipeline — automated control assessment
metadata.remarks:
Generated from conftest output by 6week-challenge/week-6/oscal-from-conftest.py. Do not hand-edit: regenerate from the verdicts. The control mapping is read from the component definition at conversion time, so this document cannot claim a control the component does not implement.

NEGATIVE CONTROL — not a production assessment. Generated from week-3/plan-broken.json, a Terraform plan with the encryption resources deliberately removed, to demonstrate that this converter emits not-satisfied when the gate denies. A pipeline that has only ever produced passing results has not been shown to be capable of producing a failing one.

results.title: Automated policy assessment of the Terraform plan
results.description: Conftest evaluated the repository's Rego policies against a Terraform plan and returned a verdict per policy package. This document is a mechanical translation of those verdicts — one observation per package, one finding per control — with no human judgement applied between the gate's output and the assessor's input.

control-selections.description: Controls assessed by automated policy evaluation against the Terraform plan, before apply.

reviewed-controls.remarks: This is a narrower set than the profile claims, and the difference is meaningful rather than an oversight. The profile scopes four controls; this assessment covers only those with a plan-time policy rule. AU-3 is assessed by a different method — examining captured runtime output — because trail delivery cannot be observed in a plan. Its evidence is linked from the component definition; it is simply not in this document, and a reader should not infer a verdict from its absence.

observations.description: Conftest evaluated policy package compliance.cm6_aws against plan-broken.json and returned no denials (1 rule(s) passed).

observations.title: Conftest verdict for compliance.sc28_aws (SC-28)
observations.description:
Conftest evaluated policy package compliance.sc28_aws against plan-broken.json and returned 2 denial(s) (0 rule(s) passed).

Denial messages, verbatim from the policy engine:
  - SC-28: aws_s3_bucket 'log' has no matching server-side encryption configuration. Remediation: add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration that references it.
  - SC-28: aws_s3_bucket 'primary' has no matching server-side encryption configuration. Remediation: add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration that references it.

findings.title: CM-6 — satisfied
findings.description: CM-6 is satisfied. The policy rule that gates it (compliance.cm6_aws) returned no denials against the assessed Terraform plan, and that rule runs as a required status check on every pull request, so the finding holds for the merged state of the repository rather than for one manual run.

findings.title: SC-28 — not-satisfied
findings.description:
SC-28 is NOT satisfied. The policy rule that gates it (compliance.sc28_aws) returned 2 denial(s) against the assessed Terraform plan. Because this rule is a required status check, a plan in this state cannot merge — the finding records a change that was stopped, not a control that is failing in production.

  - SC-28: aws_s3_bucket 'log' has no matching server-side encryption configuration. Remediation: add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration that references it.
  - SC-28: aws_s3_bucket 'primary' has no matching server-side encryption configuration. Remediation: add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration that references it.
